We are deeply saddened and disappointed to read your review.  

We agreed to continue to care for you up until the 30th March as you had been living outside of our practice area since January. We do understand that moving home can be stressful, whilst we do not currently accept out of area registrations, we made an exception until you were able to register with a surgery local to you. 

Unfortunately, your new practice have provided inaccurate information. Registration should not take 3 weeks to process, the process is instant and the electronic medical record can be accessed immediately once the forms are processed.

I have listened to the phone call recording, our team explained the process and that you would need to contact the practice you are now registered with. As your records have successfully transferred we are now unable to access your medical record. Please do get in touch with your new surgery as they should be able to help you with your medication requirements. 

Yours sincerely, 

Michelle Freeburn
